$comment: PAT-1959 sample: macOS omits all three device-class keys. This file is deliberately a payload with nothing added, because that is the whole macOS side of the contract today. Omission is valid and carries a defined meaning, identical to device_class 'unknown': score the device the way it was scored before device class existed. The seam stays platform-neutral, so if the macOS collector later gains a way to tell a server from a laptop it fills the same three keys with the same vocabulary rather than a shape of its own.
